annotations.title: El Niño and La Niña: NOAA's outlook and what they bring a country

description:
El Niño and La Niña now and ahead: NOAA CPC's alert status and its chances of each phase for the nine seasons ahead. With a country, what each phase has brought it in each season since 1950 (its wetter or drier, warmer or colder third): tendencies of the past, not a forecast.

Use for "is El Niño coming", "will El Niño make Indonesia dry this winter".

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code (e.g. IDN) or country name; leave out for the outlook

response_format.description: concise (default) answers the question; detailed adds every field the sources give

name: get_enso_outlook

attribution.description: The credit the licence asks for when it is retold

name.description: The feed's name as it is cited

la_nina.description: CPC's chance of La Niña in the season, %

additionalProperties.description: Of the phase's seasons since 1950, the share in which the country's season fell in its upper third (wetter or warmer) and its lower third (drier or colder), how many seasons, and whether the more frequent third is more frequent than chance alone would make it. By chance alone each third holds a third of the seasons, so 0.33 is no tendency. Null where the phase has no season on record

Of the phase's seasons since 1950, the share in which the country's season fell in its upper third (wetter or warmer) and its lower third (drier or colder), how many seasons, and whether the more frequent third is more frequent than chance alone would make it. By chance alone each third holds a third of the seasons, so 0.33 is no tendency. Null where the phase has no season on record

temperature.description: By phase; absent where no record holds enough of the country

la_nina.description: CPC's chance of La Niña in the season, %

season.description: CPC's three-month season and the year of its middle month, as 'NDJ 2026'

around.description: For a part of the country only: the city it is around

people_share.description: For a part: the share of the country's people there

strength.description: clear: stands from chance among every country and season tested at once; leaning: on its own only, so it may be chance

tendency.description: wetter, drier, warmer or colder than the country's usual third

years.description: In how many of the El Niño years on record, as '16 of 27 since 1950'; a third of them is what chance alone gives

ahead.description: With a country: each season CPC looks ahead to, its chances, and what each phase has brought the country in that season

chances.description: Without a country, or for one with no record: the nine seasons ahead

country.description: With a country: its iso3, name and Criora page, where the Atlas has one

credit.description: How a retelling credits the answer: Source: Criora with a link to the page the answer is about, then each originator whose data it quotes in the words its licence asks for. Concise, each credit once; detailed, by source with its name and licence, criora first

issued.description: The day CPC's latest ENSO Diagnostic Discussion was issued

next_discussion.description: The day CPC has set for the next

note.description: Why a country has CPC's chances alone, where it has

past_el_ninos.description: With a country: what past El Niños brought it in each coming season El Niño is likely in, as its Criora page says it. Each tendency once, in the season it stands furthest from chance among overlapping ones; empty where none stands from chance. Tendencies of the past, not a forecast

records.description: With a country: the record and years each variable's tendencies are read from, as 'PREC/L, 1950-2025'; GPCP from 1980 stands in for PREC/L where it holds too little of a country. Null where none is read

seasons.description: Detailed, with a country: every season, by variable, phase and season

statuses.description: CPC's ENSO Alert System status: not_active, el_nino_watch, el_nino_advisory, final_el_nino_advisory, la_nina_watch, la_nina_advisory or final_la_nina_advisory; two in a month of transition
